title: Dismantling and Re-installation of Solar panels during construction of truss work at Deep Bhavan, Cochin
summary: Two-cover e-tender for dismantling and re-installing the rooftop solar panels at the Deep Bhavan office, Cochin, while truss work is constructed.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, Gandhinagar, Kadavanthra, Cochin

sites.name: Deep Bhavan, Cochin
sites.work: Dismantling and re-installation of solar panels during construction of truss work

scope.item: Dismantling and re-installation of solar panels during construction of truss work

money.notes: EMD by DD/FDR from any nationalised/RBI approved bank in favour of The Director, Directorate of Lighthouses & Lightships, Deep Bhavan, Cochin, payable at Ernakulam; to reach one day before last day of bid submission. Small scale industries exempt from EMD with valid NSIC/MSME certificate covering the work.

eligibility: Reputed OEMs or their authorized suppliers, licensed electrical contractors, parties or Government undertakings
notes: Scanned 2-page short tender notice only; no scope details, BOQ, completion period or bid validity. Bid download/submission 01.08.2025 (09:00) to 18.08.2025 (15:00); EMD in original by 18.08.2025 15:00 in the table although clause 2 says one day before the last day; technical bid opening 19.08.2025 16:00.
